title: AMMEBA: A Large-Scale Survey and Dataset of Media-Based Misinformation In-The-Wild
reasoning: The paper focuses on a taxonomy and dataset for media-based misinformation. While it mentions religious figures or locations in specific examples of misinformation claims (e.g., the Pope or the Ram Mandir), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical systems as a primary component of the study.
